The source engine applies materialTerms and emits the exact additional-detail decline. Armageddon emits the combat-capability decline from the displayed source-engine path. These code paths show how source availability and valid source capabilities can coexist with wrong request routing.
sharedMechanisms.confidenceBoundary: Static path evidence and exact emitted branch strings support this mechanism. Native internal packet values and per-row trace logs were not captured in the report, so the precise failing predicate for every Tseramed/spell row is not asserted.

sharedMechanisms.mechanism: The all-or-none compound source path atomically declines when any decomposed question lacks a complete answer; the failed first turn then leaves later pronominal follow-ups without a successfully established source subject.
sharedMechanisms.finding: sourceQuestions checkpoints the knowledge router, requires each part to answer with record IDs, sources and evidence, and restores the checkpoint upon any unproved part. It emits the exact observed I could not ground every part...Unanswered message. The dispatch branch resets or preserves topic based on that atomic result. Full dialogue rows show first-turn seller/build/execution claims declined, followed by pronoun-based reward, working-folder or AUTO_RESTART questions that also fail. The original sources contain all required compound roles, so source absence is not an explanation.
sharedMechanisms.confidenceBoundary: The branch producing the atomic-decline message is identified directly by its exact text. Loss of topic as a contributor to later failures is a static-context inference, not a claim to have observed the private native state.

sharedMechanisms.mechanism: The selected or inherited single facet can override a newly requested field or omit a sibling field before answer emission; nearest-text fallbacks may contain complete facts despite a non-answer decision.
sharedMechanisms.finding: embeddingText rewrites And/Also queries using lastFacet, and generic candidate routing also assigns lastFacet before fresh requestFacet parsing for an elliptical named question. In the complete BWAPI context the preceding answer is location/console output; the next And...placement check repeats that console child rather than the separately sourced file-placement child. Candidate ranking selects one best fact under the chosen facet; Sword of Defense consequently presents a valid effect but no requested location, and SCHNAIL launch delay presents the distinct network paragraph. The nearest-text builder explicitly emits the closest-guide wrapper with sources; in two cases that wrapper nevertheless contains the entire requested claim.
sharedMechanisms.confidenceBoundary: The BWAPI stale-facet explanation has direct matching code and preceding field evidence.
